info.title: Robot Skill Hub API
info.description: Pinned robotics discovery, immediate immutable community experience and a separate reviewed canonical contribution channel. Contributor reports never establish Hub runtime verification.

get.summary: Search pinned robotics source references and supported preparation recipes

parameters.name: query_mode
parameters.description: all_terms keeps word-prefix matching. task opts into bounded ASCII English lexical ranking with at most16 content terms over at most512 hard-filtered records before text matching. query_too_broad requires narrower runtime/robot/environment filters; more text alone does not reduce scope. Task results expose query_terms, candidate_scope=hard_filtered_records, candidate_count, candidate_limit and per-row query_match scores. Preserve query_mode and hub_commit for pagination. Matches do not establish runtime compatibility.

409.description: Pinned catalog or record version changed

get.description: Complete bounded search; every letter/number query term must prefix a word, including with the static fallback. Standalone A*, D* and RRT* algorithm symbols become astar, dstar and rrtstar before matching; other terms remain required. Embedded identifiers and repeated stars keep ordinary tokenization; plain RRT remains a word-prefix query. Other punctuation separates words; nonblank queries without words return no matches, while blank queries browse. No stemming or inferred synonyms; native unicode61 Unicode/accent behavior can differ from local/static matching. Exact total, backend, coverage, generation and pinned next parameters are returned. Multiple environment filters must match one declared combination.

post.summary: Stateless read-only Model Context Protocol over Streamable HTTP
post.description: Public tools find_robot_skills, inspect_robot_skill and get_hub_capabilities. inspect_robot_skill accepts an optional explicit environment object (up to 16 documented finding environment keys with nonempty string values of at most 240 characters). Its response keeps the immutable record and adds a separate findings view: up to three exact-source/version observations, coverage and pagination, always data_only and needs_applicability_check. Optional recall failure returns findings.status=unknown with total=null and preserves the record; it never proves absence. Search does not query findings per result. No robot execution, installation or arbitrary URL fetching. Supported protocol versions 2025-03-26, 2025-06-18 and 2025-11-25.

get.summary: Read published findings for exact source and record pins
get.description: Data only, contributor-reported trust. All supplied environment fields match the same finding, with case-insensitive string values. Accepts at most 16 environment filters, each a nonempty string of at most 240 characters without NUL. Package versions use flat package.NAME keys, never nested objects. One complete-query page with exact total and pinned next parameters; 409 rejects a changed generation.

parameters.name: package_versions
parameters.description: Exploded query object: send flat keys such as package.mesa=23.2.1. No literal package_versions parameter is sent. Package identifiers match [A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]{0,79}; these entries count toward the combined 16 environment-filter limit.
